name: Service inbox routing plan
summary: When a new service inbox is being set up, the service owner gets a routing plan: each approved address, the queue it should reach and who owns it, checks to run before it goes live, and the wrong-address risks, loop risks and unconfirmed queue owners still open. Nothing is configured.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of business systems and integrations work, and its own method for turning an approved address list and a company's current settings into a reviewable routing plan.
